skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — add subtitles to my video like CapCut does automatically — and get caption...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the "Add Subtitle to Video CapCut" skill.
- Automatically generate and burn in subtitles for uploaded video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- Quick 30-60 second processing ideal for TikTok and social media creators needing fast captions.
- Simple authentication with free trial credits—no manual API setup required.
- Supports video uploads, 1080p MP4 exports, credit checking, session tracking, and error handling.
- User prompts are matched to actions like upload, export, credits, and editing with intuitive, plain-language commands.
